messages:
maya: Heads up — Deploybot flagged an uptick in kv-cache misses causing ~2x p50 token latency for quantized llama3q variants on dedicated pools. Seeing small-batch impact in prod after runtime 2.18 rollout. sharing logs and basic traces.

deploybot: Alert 2312009999 — Observed 37% increased kv-cache miss rate for model: llama3q-q4_0 on pool: ded-gpu-a over last 20m. Related runtime: 2.18. Logs: https://logs.redwood/abc123 :warning:

liam: thanks. can we soft-pin runtime to 2.17 for that pool during the change window? prefer soft pin (routing fallback) vs hard rollback.

anika: agree. soft pin + canary to 2.17 for 1 box per rack, monitor p50/p90 and errors for 30m, then expand. annotate rollout reason for audit.

sam: FYI, SDK clients sending long-seq tokens with streaming could still hit KV rehydration behavior — need to verify serializer patch landed in 2.18? @eric any idea?

eric: serializer fix was reverted in 2.18 due to a perf regression. it's in PR #2409 targeted for 2.18.1 but not live. So soft-pin makes sense to buy time.

qa-bot: Runbook check: when you soft-pin, set header `x-runtime-preference: pin=2.17;scope=pool:ded-gpu-a` and include test prompts: `echo \"kv-stress-512\" | run-load test`. Test plan recorded: https://wiki/redwood/kvcache-edgecase :mag:

maya: Proposed command to enact soft-pin (deployctl):

```
deployctl pin --target pool:ded-gpu-a --component runtime --version 2.17 --mode soft --duration 2h --reason "kv-cache regression for llama3q-q4_0"
```

Can someone approve? @liam +1?

liam: +1. schedule for next 10-min window. I'll own monitoring dashboards and rollback if needed.

anika: I'll prepare canary dashboard and alerts. If p90 improves and top errors drop, we unpin after 2h. If not, rollback plan: full rollback to 2.17 and throttle new 2.18 rollouts.

sam: Also add SDK feature flag to force kv-cache bypass for long-seq clients as temporary mitigation: `SDK_KV_BYPASS=true` — we'll ship a client-side doc note.

maya: executing pin in 5m. Tagging release notes: 'temporary soft-pin runtime 2.17 for ded-gpu-a to mitigate kv-cache regression with quantized llama3q models; monitoring in progress.'

deploybot: Pin job started by maya. Job ID: pin-2312009999-01. Will report completion when staged.

deploybot: Pin job completed. 1/16 nodes pinned (soft routing). Monitoring 30m window now.

eric: initial numbers from pinned node show p50 down ~25%, kv-miss down ~40% on pinned node. promising signal but small sample.

maya: keeping thread open for final unpin decision and release notes sync. tagging ops-runbook and PR for 2.18.1. :white_check_mark:
